highlights: Added 207 new marketplace apps, including Dropbox, monday.com, Miro, Zapier, Webflow and Datadog, plus support for long-term agent memory via Honcho and Hindsight.
Added chat pinning, agent muting, improved file handling (up to 100 MB), in-chat video playback, and image/file sharing.
Added server management features, including provider account pooling, custom provider editing, agent personality settings, MCP access controls, and one-step agent transfers between servers.
Improved chat experience with unread-first sorting, smoother scrolling, persistent message positioning, and reduced rendering overhead during streaming replies.
Fixed numerous chat, synchronization, networking, Android sharing, provider model selection, and UI issues.
